oneLineRole: The single canonical dictionary of The Back Nine's private financial/statutory/project vocabulary — each term defined once with a pointer to its canonical home doc.

items.claim: ACA-MAGI — the income measure driving the pre-65 ACA premium credit: AGI + tax-exempt interest + the FULL (taxable AND non-taxable) Social Security benefit + excluded foreign earned income. A DIFFERENT number from IRMAA-MAGI — the two are never reused for each other. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2.

ACA-PTC (Premium Tax Credit) — the pre-65 marketplace subsidy that FALLS as ACA-MAGI rises. Modeled as a per-year fixed-point with an explicit 400%-FPL CLIFF branch. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2, research/pre65-healthcare.md.

Accumulation — the pre-retirement saving phase (contributions + market growth) the engine projects forward to a candidate work-stop date. The mirror of decumulation; a BOUNDED NEAR-RETIREMENT ON-RAMP, never a FIRE calculator. Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (C2), decisions/accumulation-fuck-off-date.md.

Act — one of the four build chapters: 1 The Engine · 2 Where You Stand · 3 The Levers You Hold · 4 The Recommended Route. Code comments say `P`n (Phase) for the same chapter; the globally-unique unit key is the join. Canonical home: roadmap.md → The ID scheme.

Outcome states — the CLOSED set the engine owns: already-failing / over-funded / on-track / borderline / off-track / indeterminate. The headline reading and copy are selected from these, NEVER from a 7th ad-hoc state. Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (U1).
items.sourceSection: already-failing / over-funded / on-track / borderline / off-track / indeterminate; also 'Outcome states' entry

items.claim: Bengen / SAFEMAX — the safe-withdrawal-rate validation anchor (the '4% rule' lineage). The engine validates a duration-conservative SAFEMAX-analogue (~3.67%) against a committed Damodaran Treasury proxy arm, NOT against a bit-exact dataset. Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (U1), research/engine-validation-and-tax.md.

Box-Muller — the transform turning uniforms into normal market draws. Kept STATELESS (no cached spare across calls) so two CRN candidates that draw in different interleavings never silently desync. Canonical home: architecture.md §2.

Bridge (earned-income bridge) — the working-years transform that nets the withdrawal DOWN by salary: `netWithdrawal = max(0, spending − earnedIncome)`; never credits a dead earner, never contributes surplus back. Canonical home: architecture.md §4.
byte-identity — synonym/cross-reference for reduce-to-spine (see reduce-to-spine).
Cardinal rule — 'calm-but-wrong is the sin.' The governing constraint on every engine decision, disclosure, and the voice itself; the bar RISES for a recommender. Canonical home: product.md §2.

Cohort tables — the SSA TR2024/Alt2 per-birth-year survival tables; the household's 1969 / 1972 cohorts drive joint-and-survivor longevity (NOT a period table, NOT a Gompertz fit). Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (U1).

copyGuard — the lint enforcing calm, honest language: a BAN-LIST (certainty verbs, catastrophe lexicon) PLUS the require-the-hedge POSITIVE lint, both reading one single-sourced token catalog. Canonical home: product.md §6, plans/3-controls.md (U10).

CRN (Common Random Numbers) — every candidate strategy, date-offset, and arm sees IDENTICAL market draws, so a difference between them is signal, not RNG luck. The load-bearing determinism contract that lets the solver rank candidates honestly. Canonical home: architecture.md §2–§3.

Damodaran arm — the committed Treasury / corporate total-return series used as the INDEPENDENT Bengen/Trinity validation proxy (no canonical bit-exact dataset exists). Canonical home: research/engine-validation-and-tax.md.

Date-search — the bounded, EXHAUSTIVE, NON-MONOTONE-ROBUST sweep over the household work-stop offset `Y` that produces the fuck-off date; reads off a QUANTIZED conservative LOWER confidence bound, NEVER a bisection. Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (C3), decisions/accumulation-fuck-off-date.md §3.
Decumulation — the retirement draw-down phase; the engine's CENTER OF GRAVITY (accumulation exists to solve for the date that hands off to it). Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md.

directional-until-pinned — a constants-table marker: a figure is provisional until confirmed against its named government/issuer primary at a pin pass (marker becomes `directionalUntilPinned: false`). Canonical home: architecture.md §8.

DK (data key) — the random key that encrypts the model exactly ONCE; the passphrase-derived and recovery-derived keys each wrap it INDEPENDENTLY, so the recovery path can never restore a stale copy. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.3.

DND/012 (externally-derived fixtures) — golden expected values must be derived by an INDEPENDENT path (hand-math, a published figure), NEVER via the engine's own formula (which would prove typing, not correctness). Canonical home: architecture.md §5. (Cited as DND 012 in project CLAUDE.md.)

DRC (delayed retirement credits) — Social Security increases for claiming after FRA. For a survivor base they are REALIZED AT THE DECEASED'S DEATH, never credited for years the worker did not live to earn. Canonical home: plans/features/social-security.md.

items.claim: FRA (full retirement age) — the Social Security age at which the unreduced PIA is paid. Canonical home: plans/features/social-security.md.
items.fossilNote: Canonical home is features/ SS plan (fossil-by-timing).

items.claim: Fuck-off date — the working/product name for the not-yet-retired household's first answer: 'when is work optional?', delivered as TWO confidence-graded dates (floor + lifestyle). The user-facing label holds the calm advisor voice. Canonical home: product.md §3, decisions/accumulation-fuck-off-date.md.

Gross-up — the tax overlay's bounded fixed-point: raise the withdrawal enough to cover spending PLUS the tax on that withdrawal. Worst-case contraction `k ≈ 0.74`, `GROSS_UP_MAX_PASSES = 128`. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.1.

Hedge (the hedge on the headline) — every recommendation/control readout must carry its probabilistic qualifier ON THE PRIMARY SURFACE, never buried in tapped-away math. Enforced by the require-the-hedge lint. Canonical home: product.md §6.

HSA — the triple-advantaged, MEDICAL-EARMARKED fourth account bucket. Covers out-of-pocket + (owner 65+) Medicare premiums tax-free — NOT ACA marketplace premiums. Never a general drawdown source. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2.

ID scheme (R / U / C / D / M / §) — the compact, stable internal join-keys (Requirement / Unit / unit-tracks / Milestone / Section) the docs and code share; defined once, NEVER shown to the user, NEVER renumbered. Canonical legend: roadmap.md → The ID scheme.

items.claim: IRMAA — the post-65 Medicare premium SURCHARGE, set on a 2-YEAR-LAGGED MAGI lookback, with hard per-person step-cliffs. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2.
IRMAA-MAGI — IRMAA's income measure: AGI + tax-exempt interest, with NO Social Security add-back. A DIFFERENT number from ACA-MAGI. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2.

KTD (Known Technical Decision) — a load-bearing build landmine recorded in a feature plan, numbered so the implementation can cite it (e.g. R40's nine KTDs). Canonical home: plans/features/other-income.md.
items.fossilNote: References R40's nine KTDs which live in the features/ other-income plan (fossil-by-timing).

items.claim: Lexicographic objective — the definition of 'best': Tier 1 never drop below the survival floor (essentials), THEN Tier 2 a user-chosen surplus goal (leave more · pay less tax · live bigger now). The objective metric EQUALS the headline metric, so a recommendation can never contradict the magic moment. Canonical home: product.md (D1 / R21).
MAGI — modified adjusted gross income. The Back Nine computes TWO DISTINCT MAGIs (see ACA-MAGI and IRMAA-MAGI) — never one shared number.
Method C (POMS) — the Social Security spousal computation: the spouse's OWN benefit in full PLUS a REDUCED EXCESS, NOT `max(own, spousal)`. Canonical home: plans/features/social-security.md.
items.fossilNote: Canonical home is features/ SS plan (fossil-by-timing).

items.claim: MFJ→single — the surviving spouse's filing-status switch the year after the first death: the same real dollars fall into ~half-width single brackets — the 'tax cliff' that is the recommendation's emotional headline. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.1.

Overlay — a ZERO-DRAW deterministic transform of the cash-flow term (tax, healthcare, accumulation inflow) fed into the SAME per-year update function as the spine; each reduces to the spine when off. Canonical home: architecture.md §4–§5.
PIA (Primary Insurance Amount) — the Social Security benefit at FRA; the per-person SS input (entered monthly, stored annually). Canonical home: plans/features/social-security.md.
items.fossilNote: Canonical home is features/ SS plan (fossil-by-timing).

items.claim: Presence-keyed — byte-identity keyed on a construct's ABSENCE from params, NOT its zero value: a zero-valued-but-constructed accumulation run is deliberately NOT byte-identical (its working-year clamp is live). Canonical home: architecture.md §5, decisions/accumulation-fuck-off-date.md §1.

reduce-to-spine — the CORE correctness invariant: every overlay, when OFF, reproduces the Trinity/Bengen-validated decumulation distribution BYTE-IDENTICALLY (same seed). The golden cases are never perturbed. Canonical home: architecture.md §5.

Recovery phrase — the client-generated BIP-39 12-word phrase that wraps the DK INDEPENDENTLY of the passphrase; the surviving spouse's primary door back into the vault. MANDATORY export at first save. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.3.
RIB-LIM — the Retirement-Insurance-Benefit limit that caps a Social Security survivor benefit. Canonical home: plans/features/social-security.md.
items.fossilNote: Canonical home is features/ SS plan (fossil-by-timing).

items.claim: RMD (required minimum distribution) — the forced annual pre-tax distribution; the age is BIRTH-YEAR-DERIVED (72 / 73 / 75), NEVER a flat 73, and is NON-CONVERTIBLE (must be taken before any conversion). Canonical home: architecture.md §7.1.

Seed — the single injected integer that makes the engine a deterministic function of `(params, seed)`. Generated by the CALLER (never inside the pure engine) and persisted BIT-IDENTICALLY through encrypt → store → decrypt. Canonical home: architecture.md §2.
items.duplicatedIn: docs/architecture.md §2; project CLAUDE.md (engine purity / seed injected by caller)

items.claim: Single shared market draw — all account buckets (pre-tax / Roth / taxable / HSA) share ONE market-return draw per year; per-bucket draws are FORBIDDEN. This makes 'no asset-location' a structural guarantee. Canonical home: architecture.md §3.
items.duplicatedIn: docs/architecture.md §3; project CLAUDE.md (single shared market draw / CRN)

items.claim: SLCSP — the Second-Lowest-Cost Silver Plan benchmark premium; a REQUIRED USER INPUT (ZIP/age-specific) that drives the ACA credit — never synthesized. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2.
Spine — the Trinity/Bengen-validated deterministic decumulation core that every overlay reduces to. Canonical home: architecture.md §5.

Survivor-spending ratio — the factor scaling a survivor's spending after the first death (~75%, grounded to the Blanchett literature, directional-until-pinned). Rides the Tier-1 survival floor, so its dangerous direction (too low) is documented. Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (U1).

The two dates — the FLOOR date (earliest offset essentials hold) and the LIFESTYLE date (earliest offset the full budget holds at the same confidence bar); they COINCIDE in the degenerate single-total-spend budget and SPLIT when the budget is itemized. Canonical home: product.md (R27).

Trinity study — the safe-withdrawal validation anchor; the engine reproduces 37/39 cohorts (≈94.9% vs the published 95.1%, SAME failing cohorts). Canonical home: plans/1-engine.md (U1), research/engine-validation-and-tax.md.

Two-pane — the laptop composition that promotes the live answer to a persistent panel beside the questions (stacks on phone); the home for the U6 band / D2 surface. Canonical home: plans/2-first-answer.md (D2).

Vault — the encrypted-at-rest local store (IndexedDB + AES-GCM under a PBKDF2-600k passphrase key); the trust layer that makes the at-rest promise provable. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.3. KEY CONSTANT: PBKDF2-600k.
validateParams (the R19 gate) — the worker-boundary gate that rejects every incomputable input BEFORE any path runs: finiteness first, domain bounds, integer seed. Canonical home: architecture.md §6.
§86 (provisional income) — the rule taxing Social Security benefits; modeled as its OWN per-year bounded fixed-point. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.1.

§202 (survivor benefit) — the Social Security survivor benefit (payable from AGE 60); its base realizes the deceased's claim age at death (lock-flat, RIB-LIM, DRC flow-through). Canonical home: plans/features/social-security.md.
items.fossilNote: Canonical home is features/ SS plan (fossil-by-timing).

items.claim: §1014 (basis step-up) — the cost-basis reset at death; modeled into the LEAVE-MORE objective because a disclosed omission can INVERT the after-tax ranking. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.1.

400% FPL cliff — the income threshold above which the ACA premium credit drops to zero. The enhanced-subsidy expiry RESTORED it for 2026 (live legislative status). A documented engine DISCONTINUITY the date-search and solver must branch on explicitly. Canonical home: architecture.md §7.2, research/pre65-healthcare.md.

100% FPL floor — the LOWER ACA eligibility threshold: below it the credit is zero, so LESS spending can mean a HIGHER net premium — the source of the legitimate `floor > lifestyle` date INVERSION. Canonical home: decisions/accumulation-fuck-off-date.md §3.

Glossary scope/discipline rule: a term is defined here ONCE if it is load-bearing enough to appear in more than one doc, with a pointer to its canonical home; every other doc references rather than re-defines. Sort order: alphabetical, with `§` and number-prefixed statutory terms grouped at the end.
